findings.title: Bearer-intent heuristic treats any Authorization header as opt-in
findings.detail: In src/auth/auth.controller.ts#login, wantsResponseToken returns true for any present Authorization header (req.headers['authorization'] !== undefined), not a valid non-empty Bearer value. A browser that ever attaches a stale/empty Authorization header would receive the raw session token in the JSON body, partially reopening [MÉDIA] 7. The known web client (web/lib/auth-client.ts) sends no Authorization header on login and reads only data.user, so this does not reopen the finding in practice. Non-blocking. Optional hardening: require a non-empty Bearer value before echoing session.token.

summary: All four MEDIUM findings correctly implemented. FEAT-001: CRON_SECRET required (>=32 chars) in production via env.validation.ts validate(); DTO stays optional for non-prod; cron controller timingSafeEqual check preserved. FEAT-002: helmet header hardening (frameguard deny, nosniff, prod-only HSTS; CSP and CORP intentionally off for CORS allowlist + inline DANFE PDF) and Swagger wrapped in non-production gate in main.ts. FEAT-003: login body session.token conditioned to Bearer-intent callers; httpOnly signed cookie preserved unchanged. FEAT-004: collaborator portal migrated to class-level ColaboradorAuthGuard (protected-by-default) + per-handler ColaboradorRequirePasswordChangedGuard; login/logout/session public; logo and trocar-senha authenticated but not password-gated; FEAT-003 tokenVersion revocation check preserved verbatim; revocation spec rewritten to test the guard directly (6 cases). Verification: npx tsc --noEmit = 22 errors all pre-existing fiscal-spec (base refatoracao also 22; zero new, none in changed files); pnpm build passes; pnpm test = 2 failures, both known meta-presence specs, 2044 pass including the 2 new specs (32 tests). Invariants intact: [MÉDIA] 8 untouched (setup.controller.ts and fixed password 123456 unchanged by deliberate design), app.module ThrottlerModule/APP_GUARD and prior usuarios/auth DTO + collaborator revocation fixes not undone. One non-blocking info finding on the permissive Authorization-header heuristic.
